title: Mossed Over
tagline: Brush moss off old stones to read their poems before it returns.
how_to: Drag a finger across a stone to brush the moss away; use the arrows or dots to visit the next stone.
description: Five old stones each carry a tiny poem, but moss has grown over the words. Brush it away with your finger to read, and notice that the green slowly creeps back from the edges of what you cleared.
spark: Taken literally: the moss is the medium, and it covers the poems the way it covers real stones.
proud_of: The moss regrows cell by cell from its own edges, so a cleared patch genuinely closes up like a living thing.
